features.name: normalized_glucose
features.description: Z-score normalized plasma glucose concentration, improving distance metric scaling for KNN.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents the glucose feature from dominating distance calculations due to its larger raw scale.

features.name: normalized_bmi
features.description: Z-score normalized body mass index, ensuring equal contribution to distance metrics.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes BMI variance, improving the geometry of the neighborhood space.

features.name: normalized_age
features.description: Z-score normalized age, aligning its scale with other metabolic indicators.
features.expected_model_benefit: Balances age with other features in Euclidean distance computations.

features.name: high_risk_prototype_distance
features.description: Euclidean distance to an unsupervised high-risk metabolic prototype (elevated glucose, BMI, and age) in normalized space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct similarity score to a known high-risk cluster, enhancing neighborhood separation.

features.name: healthy_prototype_distance
features.description: Euclidean distance to an unsupervised healthy metabolic prototype (normal glucose, BMI, and younger age) in normalized space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a continuous similarity measure to a baseline healthy state, aiding KNN in grouping similar profiles.

features.name: glucose_bmi_interaction
features.description: Product of normalized glucose and normalized BMI, capturing the synergistic effect of these two variables.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes non-linear interactions to the distance metric, allowing KNN to capture complex metabolic states.

features.name: insulin_resistance_proxy
features.description: Ratio of plasma glucose to insulin (when insulin is non-zero), serving as an unsupervised proxy for insulin resistance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a physiologically relevant continuous feature that improves the semantic meaning of distances.

features.name: pedigree_age_risk_score
features.description: Interaction between diabetes pedigree function and the log of age, representing accumulated genetic risk over time.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines genetic predisposition with temporal exposure, creating a unified risk dimension for distance calculation.

features.name: missing_value_indicator_count
features.description: Count of biologically implausible zero values across key measurements (glucose, blood pressure, skin thickness, insulin, BMI).
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups records with similar patterns of missing data, preventing artificial proximity between complete and incomplete records.

features.name: blood_pressure_deviation
features.description: Absolute normalized deviation of blood pressure from a typical healthy baseline of 72 mm Hg.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms a bidirectional variable into a unidirectional magnitude of abnormality, improving distance semantics.

features.name: semantic_metabolic_severity
features.description: Semantic assessment of the overall severity of the metabolic profile based on the combination of glucose, BMI, and insulin levels.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, non-linear evaluation of metabolic health that smooths out noise in individual features for better neighborhood formation.

features.name: semantic_genetic_risk_profile
features.description: Evaluates the genetic risk profile by semantically interpreting the pedigree function in the context of age and number of pregnancies.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates complex, multi-variable genetic and demographic interactions into a single continuous dimension for KNN.
